| Ticket | Effort | Uncertainty |
|---|---|---|
| interrupt-turn-steer-in-place | 5 | 4 |
| actions-agent-two-branch-names | 2 | 5 |
| dashboard-ux-notes | 2 | 5 |
| cursor-parity-checklist | 3 | 8 |
| cold-read-follow-ups | 3 | 6 |

| the other 8 | 4–8 | 5–7 |

The two effort-2 tickets (actions-agent-two-branch-names and dashboard-ux-notes) come closest. Both still have uncertainty 5, so a person should pick the approach before an agent works them. The queue is empty, and no ticket is held by anyone or in review.
